intervention: Identical position-actuator commands across material models. Replay approach/support to 5.9 s; freeze command 1 or 12 s; continuous translated withdrawal; observe 15 s after withdrawal. Actual tool position and forces remain dynamic.

material_hypotheses.elastic: Original 45 MPa equilibrium truss, existing viscous damping; fixed rest shape.
material_hypotheses.relaxing: Original equilibrium branch plus equal-stiffness rotational Maxwell arm at all 42 truss joints; tau_relax=3 s, local scalar tau_creep=6 s. All numbers are uncalibrated sensitivity choices.
material_hypotheses.retained: Before trial, assign half loaded joint rotation to fixed rest curvature and double spring stiffness, preserving initial restoring moments. No growth, damage or plastic flow during trial.

unknown_parameter_ranges.equilibrium_truss_modulus_mpa: 45 inherited modeling assumption, not a published fruit-stalk calibration
unknown_parameter_ranges.relaxation_time_s: 3 illustrative; alternative 1/10/100 s scalar sensitivity, not biological bounds

outcome_not_acceptance: Residual curvature, force relaxation and recovery time are model predictions. Do not tune them to pass a preferred rebound appearance.
limitations: No real recovery observations fitted. Fixed crown, rigid fruit, no cutting, tissue damage, measured relaxation spectrum or evolved growth history. One relaxing branch is a discrimination prototype, not an established plant constitutive law.
